findings.title: Committed generated artifacts drift without a gate
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: version.json is untracked and gitignored (.gitignore:76), SBOM/license artifacts stay untracked, and CI runs scripts/openapi-audit.js (.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:59) plus `node scripts/public-route-inventory.mjs --check` (:133). Residual unchanged: docs/openapi.yaml (16,867 lines) is still not regenerated-and-diffed in CI; `generate:openapi` exists at apps/api/package.json:14, but no workflow runs it followed by `git diff --exit-code`, so the committed YAML can drift from apps/api/src/openapi/spec.ts.

findings.title: Duplicate schema bootstrap SQL can be mistaken for the source of truth
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: docs/portal_platform_formal_handoff_bundle/supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.sql:16-21 still carries the 'HISTORICAL / GENERATED COPY - DO NOT EDIT (INV-P2-002)' header pointing at the live migration chain, so the copy cannot be mistaken for the bootstrap source.

findings.title: Large committed prompt/audit corpus inflates the application repository
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: prompts/PROVENANCE.md:10-14 pins the corpus (624 pinned files, 626 tracked including manifest/PROVENANCE) and .github/workflows/validate.yml:145-148 runs `node scripts/verify-prompts.js verify` as a deploy gate; the command reports 'Prompt provenance OK - all files match manifest (624 files, 8.9 MiB)' at this commit.

findings.title: Stale, machine-specific repo path in the agent reference
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: AGENTS.md:3 names the canonical slug `github.com/MaineCyberTech/mainecybertech`, and the review.md mirror check remains wired in CI (.github/workflows/validate.yml:150+ / scripts/sync-review-md.mjs --check).

findings.title: Committed build artifact apps/web/public/version.json is stale and unguarded
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/web/public/version.json is absent from the tree and is gitignored at .gitignore:76; the file is generated by apps/web/scripts/generate-version.js before dev/build.

findings.title: Vestigial Vercel deploy configs remain after the DigitalOcean migration
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: `git ls-files | grep -E 'vercel|version\.json|snippets'` returns no tracked paths; the Vercel configs were removed after the DigitalOcean migration.

findings.title: Previous-run audit artifacts are amended in place without rebinding to the commit they now reflect
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: docs/audits/README.md:65-71 retains the 'Bind every reconciliation' rule (dated RECONCILIATION file recording amendment date, develop commit/PR range, and manifest binding), and both amended published runs still carry RECONCILIATION_2026-10-12.md.

findings.title: Committed Supabase Studio scratch snippet duplicates a dev seed
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: supabase/snippets/ does not exist in the tree; the committed Studio scratch snippet was removed.

findings.title: Service worker asset apps/web/public/sw.js is not registered anywhere
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/web/components/ServiceWorkerRegistrar.tsx:22-24 registers /sw.js with scope '/' (production only), and next.config.mjs serves its headers.

findings.title: Two migrations share numeric version 5302463, failing the repository preflight check and risking a skipped migration
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a5: supabase/migrations/5302463_client_portal_ai_and_visibility.sql and supabase/migrations/5302463_fix_notification_key_dedup_index.sql share the version prefix 5302463. scripts/preflight-check.sh:50-51 derives versions with `cut -d_ -f1 | sort | uniq -d` and asserts 'No duplicate migration timestamps'; running that expression at this commit prints 5302463 and fails. .github/workflows/supabase-migrations.yml:71-90 applies migrations with `supabase db push --include-all`, which keys migrations by that version, so at least one of the pair can be skipped (or the push can fail) on a fresh environment.
